changelog:
TokenFlow v1.0.0 — 2026-04-27
What: File/URL → structured text. Agent-agnostic.
Converts: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, audio (transcription), ZIP, URLs.
Config: Agent-side config.json — per-filetype rules (convert / skip / ask).
API: POST /convert, /convert/url, /convert/preview (XLSX sheets), /health, /usage.
Error handling: Quota → tell user. Too large / unsupported → skip. 5xx → retry once, fallback.
Install: openclaw skills install tokenflow or drop in ~/.hermes/skills/.
Needs: TOKENFLOW_API_KEY + network to tokenflow.fly.dev.
Live: tokenflow.ironlion.cc
summary: Convert files and URLs to structured text using the TokenFlow API with customizable per-filetype conversion and fallback options.
